title: Shopping on Your Phone
topic: ข่าว/ข้อมูล
lines: Online shopping in Thailand has grown rapidly over the past five years.
According to a recent report, about 70 percent of Thai internet users
bought something online last year, compared with only 40 percent in
2018. Clothes and beauty products were the most popular items, followed
Younger shoppers are leading the change. People aged 18 to 34 make up more
than half of all online buyers, and **they** spend most of their money
through mobile apps rather than websites. Older shoppers, however, still
prefer to see products before buying **them**, especially expensive items.
The growth has not been good news for everyone. Many small shops in
traditional markets have lost customers, and **some** have closed. To
survive, a number of shop owners now sell through social media as well
